# Module widgets — Smart Home

The Smart Home module's widgets (`SmartHome/ui`, library `SmartHomeUI`) are
not framework elements - they are built **out of** the elements above, and
are listed here so nobody writes a second light switch or thermostat panel.
Each drives its device through `SmartHomeAPI` and reports through its own
callback; each has getters for the elements inside it. More
in [the module's overview](../../UltraCanvas/../Modules/Smarthome/README.md).

## Elements

| Element | What it is for | Callbacks |
|---|---|---|
| [`SmartHomeAutomationEditor`](../Elements/SmartHomeAutomationEditor.md) | Editing a scene or an automation | `SetOnSave`, `SetOnCancel` (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeBlindControl`](../Elements/SmartHomeBlindControl.md) | A blind's position, tilt and presets | `SetOnPositionChange`, `SetOnTiltChange` (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeDeviceCard`](../Elements/SmartHomeDeviceCard.md) | One device or scene as a press target | `SetOnClick`, `SetOnLongPress`, `SetOnToggle` (+5 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeDeviceDialog`](../Elements/SmartHomeDeviceDialog.md) | A device's details with its control | `SetOnClose`, `SetOnRename`, `SetOnRemove` (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeEnergyMonitor`](../Elements/SmartHomeEnergyMonitor.md) | Power and energy use | (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeGroupControl`](../Elements/SmartHomeGroupControl.md) | A group of devices switched together | `SetOnGroupChanged` (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeLightControl`](../Elements/SmartHomeLightControl.md) | A light's on/off, brightness, colour temperature, colour and presets | `SetOnStateChange` (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeLockControl`](../Elements/SmartHomeLockControl.md) | A lock with its battery and activity | `SetOnLock`, `SetOnUnlock` (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeNetworkTopology`](../Elements/SmartHomeNetworkTopology.md) | The radio network as a graph | `SetOnNodeSelected`, `SetOnNodeActivated` (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomePairingWizard`](../Elements/SmartHomePairingWizard.md) | Adding a device | `SetOnComplete`, `SetOnCancel` (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomePanel`](../Elements/SmartHomePanel.md) | A dashboard of the home's devices: grid, rooms, list, scenes, automations, network | (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeSceneCard`](../Elements/SmartHomeSceneCard.md) | One device or scene as a press target | `SetOnActivate` (+5 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeSceneEditor`](../Elements/SmartHomeSceneEditor.md) | Editing a scene or an automation | `SetOnSave`, `SetOnCancel` (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeScheduler`](../Elements/SmartHomeScheduler.md) | Timed events by day, week or as a list | `SetOnEventSelected`, `SetOnEventCreate` (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeSensorDisplay`](../Elements/SmartHomeSensorDisplay.md) | A sensor's reading and its recent history | (+8 inherited) |
| [`SmartHomeThermostatControl`](../Elements/SmartHomeThermostatControl.md) | A thermostat's target and mode | `SetOnStateChange` (+8 inherited) |
